title: Driving Feel, Styling, and Feature Impressions
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on favorable driving feel and a few appearance or accessory compliments, while many other fragments are too fragmentary or mixed in subject to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise responsive and enjoyable driving, exterior lighting, and the perceived quality of accessories such as floor mats.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention varied subjects including general operation, cabin roominess, styling, search, access, climate controls, prompts, fuel savings, and technology learning difficulty without enough clear sentiment evidence to summarize more firmly.

limitations: Most fragments in this topic are undetermined, limiting confidence in a tighter thematic summary.
The undetermined examples mix unrelated subjects such as styling, cabin space, infotainment search, access features, climate controls, and fuel savings.
Several fragments are partial statements, so the full customer intent or sentiment may be missing.
